text: Covers accidental damage to the insured vehicle, including collision, overturning and damage from falling objects. Sum insured up to Rs. 5,00,000 per incident. Standard deductible Rs. 1,000. Excludes wear and tear, mechanical breakdown, and damage while driving without a valid licence. Claims must be reported within 7 days of the incident.
title: Motor own-damage cover

exclusions.text: damage to the insured's own vehicle

text: Covers legal liability for third-party injury or property damage arising from use of the insured vehicle. Limit Rs. 7,50,000 per incident. No deductible. Excludes damage to the insured's own vehicle and any incident while driving without a valid licence.
title: Motor third-party liability

text: Covers total loss of the insured vehicle due to theft or burglary. Sum insured up to Rs. 5,00,000. An FIR must be filed within 24 hours of discovering the theft, and the claim must be reported within 7 days.
title: Motor theft cover

text: Covers in-patient hospitalisation expenses including room rent, surgery and medicines. Sum insured up to Rs. 10,00,000 per year. A 30-day waiting period applies to illnesses (not to accidents). Pre-existing conditions are excluded for the first 2 years of the policy. Day-care procedures are covered; OPD treatment is not covered.
title: Hospitalisation cover

text: Covers listed day-care procedures that do not require 24-hour hospitalisation, such as cataract surgery and dialysis. Sum insured up to Rs. 10,00,000 per year. Same waiting-period and pre-existing exclusions as hospitalisation cover.
title: Day-care procedures

text: Covers delivery and pre/post-natal hospitalisation up to Rs. 50,000. A 9-month waiting period applies from the policy start date.
title: Maternity cover

text: Covers loss or damage to home and contents from fire, lightning and burglary. Sum insured up to Rs. 25,00,000. Burglary claims require an FIR. Excludes wear and tear and damage from poor maintenance.
title: Fire and burglary cover

text: Covers damage to home and contents from flood, earthquake, storm and landslide. Sum insured up to Rs. 25,00,000. Standard deductible Rs. 5,000.
title: Natural calamity cover

text: Covers non-refundable trip costs if the trip is cancelled for a covered reason (illness, death in family, natural disaster). Limit Rs. 1,00,000. Proof of the reason is required.
title: Trip cancellation cover

text: Covers loss of checked-in baggage during travel, up to Rs. 50,000. A Property Irregularity Report from the airline is required.
title: Baggage loss cover
